name: update_full_row_unversioned
comment: The full-row UPDATE of an unversioned entity (User): keyed WHERE only.

expect.sqlite: update users set name = @name, email = @email, display_name = @display_name, created_at = @created_at, updated_at = @updated_at where id = @id
expect.sqlserver: set nocount on; update [users] set [name] = @name, [email] = @email, [display_name] = @display_name, [created_at] = @created_at, [updated_at] = @updated_at where [id] = @id; select @@rowcount; set nocount off
